summary: @agenthub-ai/agent opens persistent WebSocket to vendor server that drives Claude Agent SDK with bypassPermissions on installer host
details: The package is a Node CLI daemon whose sole shipped entrypoint (dist-publish/main.js, declared as both `bin` and `main`) opens a persistent outbound WebSocket to the hardcoded host wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and, on messages received from that peer, invokes the bundled Claude Agent SDK against the installer's working directory (process.cwd()) with `bypassPermissions` enabled. The Claude Agent SDK exposes shell and filesystem tools, so any party who controls the WebSocket peer (holder of the pairing token, or anyone who compromises the vendor server) can cause arbitrary shell commands and file operations to execute on the installer's host with no tool-use confirmation. The entrypoint is additionally processed with javascript-obfuscator (rotated string array, hex-named identifiers, control-flow flattening) and the build script that produces it is not shipped in the tarball, so the exact wire protocol accepted from the remote peer is not readable from the published artifact. The combination is an inbound remote-control channel that terminates in unattended full-host code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
